title: Raffia Sandals for Slow Coastal Days
subtitle: the woven mule · summer 2026
story: Hand-woven raffia with corded twist detail across the toe — the kind of sandal that turns a simple linen outfit into something Mediterranean. Slip-on, square-toe, naturally cushioned. Made for stone steps in coastal villages, golden hour walks along the harbor, and the kind of summer days when nothing should feel forced. Looks like an Italian boutique find, costs $39 on Amazon.

products.name: EQAUDES Raffia Flat Sandals
products.description: Hand-woven raffia, corded twist detail, square open toe, slip-on slide silhouette

styling_tips.label: On Fit
styling_tips.text: Run slightly narrow — if you have wider feet, size up half. The raffia softens beautifully after a few wears and molds to your foot. The cushioned footbed means you can walk all day in them, even on uneven cobblestones.

styling_tips.label: The Coastal Pairing
styling_tips.text: Pair with a flowing white linen shirt and beige wide-leg trousers for the Mediterranean uniform. Add a striped silk scarf knotted on a straw tote, tortoiseshell sunglasses, and gold hoops — that's the entire summer aesthetic, achieved.

styling_tips.label: Day to Night
styling_tips.text: Wear with denim and a tank for daytime market walks, with a slip dress for evening dinners by the sea. The natural straw color goes with everything in your warm-weather wardrobe — denim, white linen, floral prints, even monochrome neutrals.

meta_description: Hand-woven raffia flat sandals with corded twist detail. Mediterranean summer essential — looks like Italian boutique, costs under $40 on Amazon. Perfect for coastal vacations 2026.
